description: This file defines algorithms and data structures for sparsification and value ranking in sparse tensor computations on CUDA, including greedy algorithms for selecting indices in 4x4 tiles based on value magnitude, with support for different ranking operations.

classes.name: TileValueOrderedT
classes.description: Template struct representing a 4x4 tile value with ordering based on a pointwise operation.

classes.name: IdentityOp
classes.description: Operation struct that returns the input value unchanged.

classes.name: AbsOp
classes.description: Operation struct that returns the absolute value of the input.

classes.name: LargestValuesGreedy
classes.description: Template struct implementing a greedy algorithm to select indices of largest values in a 4x4 tile under sparsity constraints.

classes.name: Causal1122
classes.description: Template struct implementing a causality-preserving sparsity pattern algorithm for 4x4 tiles.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the index selection algorithm on a given 4x4 tile accessor.

methods.name: outOfBoundsFillValue
methods.description: Returns a fill value for out-of-bounds indices, defaulting to negative infinity.

methods.name: named_algorithms
methods.description: Registers different sparsification algorithms with a callback.
